verdict.rationale: Better Stack documents an Uptime API with bearer-token auth, and its tokens are described as managing Uptime resources or "anything within Better Stack". It also ships an MCP server usable from Claude Code. However, the MCP server is described only in terms of telemetry (logs, metrics, traces, errors), and incident acknowledge/resolve is documented only via Slack, phone, and app taps, not as API or MCP actions. missing for 10: explicitly documented API/MCP endpoints for acknowledging, escalating, and resolving incidents; evidence the MCP server exposes incident actions rather than just telemetry; a published OpenAPI spec (all candidate paths 404); hands-on corroboration of a fully agent-driven incident lifecycle.
